title: timezonelocalizedname
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, timezonedefinitionid.

createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

cultureid.description: Unique identifier of the culture that the UI names are encoded in.

daylightname.description: Name of the time zone for the daylight time.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

standardname.description: Name of the time zone for the standard time.

userinterfacename.description: Unique display name for the time zone in the Microsoft Windows registry.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the record.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the timezonelocalizedname.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the time zone localized name.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the timezonelocalizedname.

_timezonedefinitionid_value.description: Unique identifier of time zone definition entity instances.
